info.title: Wise Owl Demeanor
info.description: Wise Owl Demeanor (known as Demeanor for .NET, Enterprise Edition through 5.x) is the original .NET obfuscator, shipping since 1999. Demeanor protects your intellectual property without breaking your app: it reads the compiled assembly first, recognizes framework patterns (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Blazor, WPF, WinForms, MAUI, System.Text.Json, COM), and tells you in plain English what obfuscates cleanly, what breaks, and what code changes would fix it. Then it obfuscates: renames identifiers, encrypts strings, constants, and resources, obfuscates control flow, and injects anti-tamper and anti-debug protections. Per-company Enterprise licensing — one annual key, unlimited developers and build agents, no phone-home, no machine locking, no activation server. Optional Large Language Model (LLM) integration via a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server lets customers who already use an MCP-capable AI assistant — Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue.dev — drive the audit as a conversation; runs locally over stdio. Editions: Community (single-assembly renaming) / Enterprise (per company, full transform suite). Pricing and purchase: https://www.wiseowlsoftware.com/pricing.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Pre-obfuscation risk analysis — detect framework patterns that break after obfuscation.

options.name: --include-deps
options.description: Also audit co-located private dependencies.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output structured JSON instead of terminal table.

options.name: --no-baml
options.description:
Report WPF findings as if BAML patching is disabled (types need manual
exclusion).

options.name: --project
options.description:
Project root holding .demeanor/ (rules and resolved decisions). Defaults to
the nearest ancestor of the assembly that contains a .demeanor directory —
the same resolution an obfuscation run uses.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the .NET assembly to audit.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Detect whether an assembly has already been obfuscated by Demeanor.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the .NET assembly to check.

commands.name: deobfuscate
commands.description: Map obfuscated names in a crash stack trace back to originals.

options.name: --report
options.description: Path to the JSON report file.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File containing the obfuscated stack trace. Omit to read from stdin.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Wire automatic Release-build obfuscation into a .csproj in the current directory.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the .csproj to wire. Skips the single-directory discovery pass
entirely.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the MSBuild snippet that would be added, but do not modify any files.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description:
Optional path to a Release build assembly. If supplied, runs an audit and prints
suggested exclusions before writing MSBuild integration.

commands.name: license
commands.description: Decode and display license key information.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description:
Base64-encoded license key to decode. Also reads from DEMEANOR_LICENSE environment
variable.

commands.name: report
commands.description: View an obfuscation report in human-readable format.

options.name: --section
options.description:
Section to display: summary, excluded, renamed-types, renamed-methods,
renamed-fields, statistics, advisories. [default: summary]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter results by name (substring match).

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of results.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the JSON report file.

commands.name: validate-exclusions
commands.description: Test exclusion rules against real metadata without obfuscating.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude patterns (fully-qualified names, repeatable).

options.name: --xr
options.description: Regex exclusion patterns (repeatable).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the .NET assembly to test against.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory for the obfuscated assembly.

options.name: --include-publics
options.description:
Also obfuscate public/protected symbols. Without this
flag, publicly visible types and members in library DLLs
are preserved. Use for executables that are not
referenced by other assemblies.

options.name: --include-deps
options.description:
Also obfuscate co-located private dependency assemblies
(transitive closure). System and third-party assemblies
are loaded for reference only.

options.name: --names
options.description:
Name generation mode: Alpha (a,b,c) or Unicode (Canadian
Aboriginal Syllabics — most systems lack the font).
[default: Alpha]

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Namespace prefix for obfuscated top-level types.

options.name: --proxy-threshold
options.description:
Minimum IL body size (bytes) for same-assembly methods
to be proxied. Default/minimum: 16. [default: 16]

options.name: --keyfile
options.description: Strong name key file (.snk) for re-signing.

options.name: --keycontainer
options.description: Strong name key container for re-signing.

options.name: --no-serializable
options.description: Exclude serializable types and their serializable fields.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Exclude a type or member by fully-qualified name
(repeatable).

options.name: --xr
options.description: Exclude types/members matching a regex pattern

options.name: --xa
options.description: Exclude an assembly from obfuscation by name

options.name: --add-assembly
options.description: Include a dynamically referenced assembly (repeatable).

options.name: --no-satellite-assemblies
options.description:
Leave satellite assemblies untouched. Renaming without
updating them makes a localized application fall back to
its neutral culture at runtime.

options.name: --sa-cultures
options.description: Specific cultures for satellite assembly processing

options.name: --prior-report
options.description:
Prior version's JSON report for incremental obfuscation
(preserves name mappings).

options.name: --report
options.description:
Generate a JSON report mapping original to obfuscated
names. Optionally pass a filename: `--report path.json`.
Without a filename, the report is written next to the
obfuscated assembly.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Simulate obfuscation: run the full pipeline (including
the report) but write the obfuscated assembly to a
discardable temp directory instead of the configured
output directory. Use to preview the rename map and
statistics without touching the real output.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Display verbose obfuscation statistics.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress all non-error output.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Preserve debug data (PDB) in the output assembly.

options.name: --no-logo
options.description: Suppress the startup banner.

options.name: --license
options.description:
Base64-encoded license key. Also reads from
DEMEANOR_LICENSE environment variable.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Project root holding .demeanor/ (rules and resolved
decisions). Defaults to the nearest ancestor of the
input assembly that contains a .demeanor directory. The
MSBuild integration always passes this explicitly.

options.name: --fail-on-pending-decisions
options.description:
Exit non-zero if any needs-decision rule matched a
symbol nobody has resolved. Those symbols are always
left unrenamed; this turns that into a build failure
instead of a report.

options.name: --cfg
options.description:
Control flow obfuscation strength. Weakest first: none
-> reorder -> predicates -> flatten. [default: flatten]

options.name: --rename
options.description:
Renaming of every kind of symbol. 'aggressive'
additionally moves renamed members to privatescope so
they share one name and leave the type's namespace.
Weakest first: off -> on -> aggressive. [default:
aggressive]

options.name: --enum-deletion
options.description:
Deletion of enum member fields. Reaches only enums that
were renamed. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --string-encryption
options.description:
Encryption of literal strings. Weakest first: off -> on.
[default: on]

options.name: --constant-encryption
options.description:
Encryption of integer constants. Weakest first: off ->
on. [default: on]

options.name: --call-hiding
options.description:
Relay methods that hide intra-assembly call targets from
static analysis. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --anti-debug
options.description:
Debugger detection scattered across method entry points.
Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --anti-tamper
options.description:
A module initializer that verifies the file has not been
modified. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --baml
options.description:
Patching of compiled XAML so it tracks renamed types and
properties. Turning this off freezes everything BAML
references from renaming instead. Weakest first: off ->

options.name: --rename-types
options.description:
Type names. Enumerations sit inside this: turning it off
turns off enum renaming, and with it enum member
deletion. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-enums
options.description:
Enumeration type names. Enum member deletion reaches
only enums that were renamed, so turning this off turns
that off too. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-methods
options.description: Method names. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-fields
options.description: Field names. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-properties
options.description:
Property names. Data-bound and serialized properties are
protected automatically whatever this is set to. Weakest
first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-events
options.description: Event names. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-parameters
options.description: Parameter names. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --rename-resource-names
options.description: Managed resource names. Weakest first: off -> on.

options.name: --resource-encryption
options.description: Encryption of embedded resources. Weakest first: off ->

options.name: --virtual-rename
options.description:
MethodImpl-based renaming of overrides of external
methods, including ToString and interface
implementations. Weakest first: off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --hinder-reflection
options.description:
Metadata constructs that hinder reflection-based tools,
and suppression of ILDASM disassembly. Weakest first:
off -> on. [default: on]

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the .NET assembly to obfuscate.
